rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires, the shot power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive, and the tank's energy at the start of the turn must be strictly greater than the shot's power.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))
rules.why: Verus gave no line, only a note that the helper `clamp_to` is outside the verified code, so S1 is unproven rather than shown to fail; reading the firing code, power is 3000 when energy is above 3000, otherwise energy minus 1, and it is only set when energy is above 100, so the power looks affordable and at least 100, but that is my reading, not a proof.

deleted_starters.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.

explanation.headline: Not proved: Verus couldn't check rule S1 (never fire a shot you can't afford)
explanation.summary: Verus returned "unknown" for S1 because the code calls `clamp_to`, a function it ignores as external, so the rule was neither proved nor shown broken. The battles reported no S1 violations in either arena; they flagged only S2 (first on turn 0) and S3 (first on turn 2), and neither is in the spec I was given, so I can't say what they cover.
